description: §8.10 Tier 2 loop hoisting (RUNTIME, sqlEngine:"real"): one key cannot be bound as a SQL parameter (an object, an array). Only THAT key's read fails — the other reads return their rows — exactly as the per-iteration queries do. Each cell equals the same function compiled with `.nobatch()`. Pre-fix (2dd6d35d9 and e7671481c, S456 fix round F1): the bad key failed the whole pre-fetch and that failure was handed to every read, valid keys included (handled "QF,QF,QF,QF", handledAll "0,0"). Now a chunk that fails loads none of its keys and each such read runs its own one-key query when it runs.
rationale: §8.10.3: "The rewritten loop is observationally equivalent to the un-rewritten loop on all side-effect orderings." §19.8.3: a handled query's failure reaches ITS handler.
